steps: New-script and re-edit samples leave generated source, draft and author bytes unchanged. Missing shared keys, all/any short circuit, first-match selection, fallback, unknown events and invalid numeric input are explicit; field location selects the corresponding author row.

Chinese English Japanese retain numeric input identity focus selection and preview at 390px. Changing a real condition invalidates both trial and source review; removed locate controls cannot retarget a row. Cancel/reopen clears trial session and leaves the author source unchanged.

The unchanged saved v5 table is separately planned built and run in real Godot. Its publisher supplies shared enabled=true and event value3; actual entries are idle then attack, consistent with the manual sample. Runtime provenance remains independent evidence.
